import re
for s in ["42", "\u096a\u0968"]:          # the second string is Devanagari four, two
    print(repr(s), "\\d+:", bool(re.fullmatch(r"\d+", s)), " [0-9]+:", bool(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", s)))
description: You can see which digit characters two patterns accept.
